strategies.name: opening_range_fvg_retest_scalp
strategies.entry_summary: On the 5-minute opening range, mark the high/low of the first 9:30-9:35 candle, then switch to the 1-minute chart and wait for price to break the opening-range level with a fair value gap. Wait for price to retest the fair value gap and enter only after the retest candle is engulfed in the trade's方向
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop loss one tick beyond the deepest point price traded into the fair value gap, and take profit at a fixed 3:1 reward-to-risk target. No active management after entry.

strategies.name: opening_range_fvg_limit_entry_day_trade
strategies.entry_summary: On the 15-minute opening range, mark the high/low of the first 9:30-9:45 candle, then switch to the 5-minute chart and wait for price to break the opening-range level with a fair value gap. Instead of waiting for a retest confirmation candle, place a limit order at the fair value gap so entry occurs
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop loss at/under the first candle of the fair value gap pattern, and take profit at a fixed 2:1 reward-to-risk target. No active management after entry.

result.enumeration_note: The video teaches two distinct entry/exit skeletons: a scalping FVG retest with engulfing confirmation and 3:1 target, and a day-trading FVG limit-entry variant using different opening-range timeframe, confirmation mechanic, and 2:1 target.
